commands: set -eu; echo '=== EXECUTOR ==='; pwd; echo '=== WORKTREES ==='; git worktree list --porcelain; echo '=== WORKTREE AUDIT ==='; git worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | while IFS= read -r wt; do echo "--- WORKTREE: $wt ---"; git -C "$wt" status --short --branch || true; echo 'HEAD:'; git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD || true; echo 'BRANCH:'; git -C "$wt" branch --show-current || true; echo 'RECENT:'; git -C "$wt" log --oneline --decorate -5 || true; echo 'UNSTAGED_NAME_STATUS:'; git -C "$wt" diff --name-status || true; echo 'STAGED_NAME_STATUS:'; git -C "$wt" diff --cached --name-status || true; echo 'DIFF_STAT:'; git -C "$wt" diff --stat || true; echo 'STAGED_STAT:'; git -C "$wt" diff --cached --stat || true; done
